text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors have expressed frustration with the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as excessive and unhelpful for learning. Several reviews noted poor lighting in exhibit areas and a lack of clear signage, which made navigation difficult. There were also complaints about the food service, including slow preparation and low quality. Some visitors found the timed entry system confusing and suggested booking early slots to avoid crowds. Overall, while most ratings remain positive, these issues with exhibit presentation, wayfinding, and visitor services stand out as areas needing attention.
